summary: P2: source-backed coverage denominator with explicit non-authoritative fallback.

design.source_capture: IngestionProcessor now records per-chain source polymer-sequence evidence (metadata.source_sequences). Basis precedence: valid label_seq_id across all polymer residues of a chain -> positions = max(label_seq_id), basis=label_seq_id; otherwise unavailable.
design.coverage_contract: When source positions are available: numerator = eligible core residues mapping to a source position (label_seq_id); denominator = total source polymer positions; missing positions therefore count against coverage. Law-105 status remains 70% threshold (unchanged).
design.fail_closed: When no authoritative source sequence can be established, Law-105 is computed from observed residues and is explicitly marked source_backed=False with a note that it is NOT source-backed / not authoritative. It is never presented as authoritative source-backed coverage.

missing_internal_position_1_3.before: observed-based denominator (2 observed residues) -> coverage could reach 100% excluding the missing position.
missing_internal_position_1_3.after: source denominator (3 positions) -> 2/3 = 66.67%, status FAIL; the absent position counts.

unavailable_sequence.after: computed from observed residues, source_backed=False, note present; not presented as authoritative.

real_fixtures: Synthetic label_seq_id reproductions used; real PDB/mmCIF-pinned fixtures for source-sequence alignment remain open (gemmi 0.6.7 entity.full_sequence is unreliable for PDB; label_seq_id path is the implemented authoritative basis).
